items.headline: Anthropic shares rebound nearly 11% after recent post-IPO weakness
items.summary: Anthropic shares rose nearly 11% during Friday’s shortened U.S. session, while Nasdaq, the S&P 500 and Dow also gained. The report links the week’s volatility to AI-company developments and Nvidia leadership concerns.

items.headline: Nvidia rises as broader technology shares lead Wall Street rebound
items.summary: AT Pulse reported that Nvidia’s leadership turmoil and Jensen Huang’s return remained central to the day’s AI-market narrative, while technology shares helped drive the broader market higher.

items.headline: Microsoft and Broadcom participate in broad AI-led market rebound
items.summary: AT Pulse described listed AI names as pressured by high real yields and valuation concerns, while also reporting that Microsoft and Broadcom were among companies involved in the day’s technology-market moves.

items.headline: CrowdStrike’s reported Zscaler acquisition highlighted in daily AI-investing brief
items.summary: AT Pulse included CrowdStrike’s reported acquisition of Zscaler among the day’s investment-relevant AI and cybersecurity developments.
